tests/test_a_reload_runs_the_committed_h.would_fail_if: The descriptor is not inheritable or the child cannot fstat it after exec, so READY never arrives.
The first cached image contains bytes other than the independently committed 'running' literal.
Pruning removes the live child image or fails to print its retention.
The child cannot import the retained image after pruning, imports a different value, or exits unsuccessfully.
The image remains after the child releases its descriptor, or removal is not printed.
The old open-before-lock race is restored, so a vanished inode is accepted and a plain target file remains.
A later materialization cannot recreate a directory with the independently committed second value.
Poll does not renew the lease after the test sets its mtime ten seconds in the past.
Pruning removes the active import root despite the explicit active_root argument.
The returned kept list omits the same image supplied as active_root; alone it does not independently prove retention.
Pruning after release fails to report or perform removal of the old image.

tests/test_a_reload_waits_for_a_clean_tr.would_fail_if: The deliberate post-commit working-tree edit is absent, or the cached image contains those uncommitted bytes instead of git show HEAD bytes.

tests/test_stale_producer_warning_waits_.would_fail_if: The seat cannot be claimed, it records source HEAD rather than the carried running commit, or the source stamp fails to see the newer commit.
The identity substitutes current HEAD for the running image, omits current HEAD, misclassifies the mismatch, or suppresses its warning.

findings.text: follow-on: `assert image in kept` compares the returned list with the same image supplied as `active_root`; a function that merely echoed that input would pass this line without proving the kept report reflects a live image, though the independent `image.is_dir()` assertion at line 337 guards retention.
